small_guidance:
- Switch BLOCK_OC to 32 or 64 and BLOCK_P to 32 with num_warps=8 — the current 16×64 tile underutilizes registers; the inner accumulator is BLOCK_OC×BLOCK_P and a wider OC tile lets the (wv[:,None]*xv[None,:]) outer-product amortize the shared input loads across more channels.
- Hoist the input gather out of the OC loop: for each (dy,dx,kh,kw), the loaded xv only depends on (ph,pw,ic,kh,kw,dy,dx), not on oc_offs — currently fine, but reorder loops so `ic`/`kh`/`kw` are outermost and load xv once, then accumulate against all OC in the tile. Also drop the redundant `oc_mask` on weight loads by padding OC tile.
- Wrap launch in `triton.autotune` over (BLOCK_OC∈{32,64}, BLOCK_P∈{16,32,64}, num_warps∈{4,8}, num_stages∈{2,3}) keyed on (OC, PH*PW).
large_guidance:
- Recast as an implicit-GEMM im2col: one program per (N, OC tile, pooled-spatial tile). For each pooled output (ph,pw), the GEMM-K dimension is IC*KH*KW*POOL*POOL (gather the 4×4 pool window of conv inputs as part of K). Accumulate OC×P tile in registers via `tl.dot` on BLOCK_K=32 chunks — this turns the current scalar FMA chain into tensor-core mma and should be 5-10× faster on the 4090.
- Use channels_last (NHWC) input layout so the IC axis is contiguous; the GEMM-K reduction then loads coalesced 16/32-wide IC vectors. Pre-transpose weight to (OC, KH*KW*IC) at init (constant rearrangement, not a reduction) so weight loads are contiguous along K.
- Fuse pool+sigmoid+sum into the epilogue exactly as now (multiply acc by 1/(POOL²), sigmoid, reduce over OC and P, atomic_add to out[n]) — fusion boundary is correct; only the matmul core needs replacing. Persist one program per (n, oc_tile) sweeping all pooled positions to reuse weight loads across the spatial axis.
